symptom: `alter page … set (ColumnWidth: manual, Size: 220) on dg column(Name)`: the other columns collapse at runtime; `mxcli syntax page column` documented `[, Size: integer]` with the example `ColumnWidth: manual, Size: 150`, and the quick references and create-page skill said "integer (px)" (mendixlabs/mxcli#1519 item 3a)
cause: Not a write defect: Data grid 2 renders `size` as a relative weight. Its `columnWidth` getter (Datagrid 3.4.0, Datagrid.mjs) returns `${weight}fr` for manual, `1fr` for autoFill and `minmax(<minWidthLimit>px | min-content | auto, auto)` for autoFit — so Size: 220 takes 220 shares against one per autoFill column. The documentation called it pixels
insight: For a rendering question, read the widget's own render code in the .mpk before building an app: `grep -o '.{200}"manual".{250}' Datagrid.mjs` answered fr-vs-px in one line and gave the exact CSS for each width mode. The pixel option is `ColumnWidth: autoFit, minWidth: manual, minWidthLimit: N` — writable and round-tripping on main (0 errors, 11.15.0), though the report's nightly predated that.
